description: Append geometry metadata columns (area, length, centroid, bounds, geom type) to a (Geo)DataFrame. Drop-in for Alteryx's Spatial Info tool.

outputs.description: Original columns plus selected metric columns

metrics.description: Which metrics to compute. Subset of: area, length, centroid, bounds, geom_type, num_points, is_valid. Centroid adds centroid_x + centroid_y; bounds adds minx/miny/maxx/maxy.
metrics.label: Metrics

projected_crs.description: Projected CRS used for area / length math (gives real-world units). Default is Web Mercator. For survey-grade results pick the right UTM zone (e.g. EPSG:32610 for the US West Coast).
projected_crs.label: Projected CRS

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps
